title: 第689章 菩萨的棋子还不是时候第688章 明德朝的秘密
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
听完殷哲的话，龙涛在震惊之余，也总算弄明白了一件事。
难怪明德朝的建立，会被系统算作殷哲影响诸天万界历史的行为呢。
合着京城下面压着一个合道级天魔的舌头啊？
合道级的天魔啊！别说舌头了，一块皮屑估计都能造成想象不到的灾祸，难怪明德朝在诸天里只算是一个比较强大的普通皇朝，却同时被系统和玉通天的天狼朝如此看重。
“如果那位朱太祖没能那么快平定天下，当时会很危险吧？”龙涛立刻问道。
“是的，不是一般的危险，如果那次乱世再拖延个几十上百年的话，天魔的舌头……呃……算了，还是说尸块吧，很可能就会被长期乱世带来的那股毁灭本源影响，从而重新产生活性，那可不是开玩笑的，天缺关失守，整个无周天被魔族里应外合攻陷都是有可能的。”
“那你当时正好在无周天，难道就是为了……”
殷哲不好意思的喝了口茶，
“算是吧，毕竟这事是真的严重，我当时本来打算直接过来找栖霞派处理的，但那会儿栖霞派正是衰落期，被武夷派和几个世家压的喘不过气，实在腾不出手来。总之……当时的形势真的很严峻。”
接着他又喝了口茶，吐了口气道，
“其实我最开始帮那位太祖，也只是无心之举，单纯出于同情，没想到他最后真能成事。”
“所以，大家是怕……净土宗可能会利用那个天魔的尸块？这……不可能吧。”
“理性想想确实不太可能，可这种事，没法赌。”殷哲放下茶杯，“换个角度想，无周天若不经历一场毁天灭地级别的大灾，重创世界意志，净土宗永远没法在这里站稳脚跟。所以他们会不会做出极端选择，谁也说不准。”
经殷哲这么提醒，龙涛又想到那个被水淹没的世界，还是点了点头。
二人接着又聊了些宗门内的琐事，殷哲在起身前，最后问了句。
“对了，龙涛，你有没有把谛念，做成那个奕仙图棋子，宣扬的打算吗？”
龙涛想了想，才开口，“会做的，但不是现在。起码等局势再稳一稳。”
殷哲听完，神色里浮起一丝藏不住的满意，
“就知道你小子不会糊涂。”
二人没再多言，只是相视一笑，就在殷哲起身打算离开时，龙涛却又想到了什么，

突然开口问道，
“殷哲，你如果不是吃了那个药，继续修炼下去，有可能成为大能吗？”
殷哲对这个问题明显有些意外，忍不住笑道，
“我以为你和我相处这么久，应该了解我有多废物了啊。”
“坦白说，我不了解。”龙涛难得认真地看着他，
“一直已离开都是你在说自己不行。可你真正的天赋，我根本不知道。你总说自己只是白玉京的外门弟子，但可那是白玉京啊，哪怕是最差的，放在凡人眼里，也得是天资出众的人物吧。”
殷哲张了张嘴，像是被什么话堵住了。他沉默了一会儿，才讪讪地笑了笑，
“白玉京……也有后门和推荐信的嘛。我的家族当时得到一封，我运气好抢到了。好了好了，别问这些过去的琐事了，我先走了。”
看着对方离去的背影，龙涛却知道他又在敷衍，能得到白玉京推荐信的家族，那肯定也是顶级修仙世家，能在这种家族抢到推荐信的，那肯定是家族最优秀的弟子啊。
content_en:
After listening to Yin Zhe's words, Long Tao was shocked and finally understood one thing.
No wonder the establishment of the Mingde Dynasty was systematically regarded as Yin Zhe's behavior that affected the history of all heavens and realms.
Is there a Hedao-level demon's tongue suppressed under He Jingcheng?
A Hedao-level demon! Not to mention the tongue, a piece of skin can probably cause unimaginable disasters. No wonder the Mingde Dynasty is only a relatively powerful ordinary dynasty in the world, but it is so valued by the system and the Heavenly Wolf Dynasty of Yu Tongtian.
"If Zhu Taizu hadn't been able to pacify the world so quickly, wouldn't it have been very dangerous?" Long Tao asked immediately.
"Yes, it is not an ordinary danger. If the troubled times are delayed for tens or even hundreds of years, the demon's tongue... uh... forget it, let's talk about the corpses, will probably be affected by the source of destruction brought about by the long-term troubled times and become active again. That is no joke. If the Tianque Pass is lost, it is possible that the entire Wu Zhou Tian will be attacked by the demon clan inside and outside."
"Then you happened to be in Wuzhoutian at that time. Is it because of..."
Yin Zhe took a sip of tea embarrassedly.
"That's right. After all, this matter is really serious. I originally planned to come directly to the Qixia Sect to deal with it, but the Qixia Sect was in its decline at that time. It was overwhelmed by the Wuyi Sect and several aristocratic families, and it was impossible to take action. In short... the situation at that time was really serious."
Then he took another sip of tea, exhaled and said,
"Actually, when I first helped the Taizu, it was just an unintentional move, purely out of sympathy. I didn't expect that he would actually succeed in the end."
"So, everyone is afraid that... the Pure Land Sect might use the corpse of that demon? This is... impossible."
"It's really impossible to think rationally, but there's no way to bet on this kind of thing." Yin Zhe put down his teacup. "Thinking about it from another perspective, if Wu Zhoutian didn't experience a catastrophic disaster that would destroy the world and severely damage the world's will, the Pure Land Sect would never be able to gain a foothold here. So whether they will make an extreme choice, no one can say for sure."
After being reminded by Yin Zhe, Long Tao thought of the world submerged by water again and nodded.
The two then chatted about some trivial matters within the sect, and Yin Zhe asked one last question before standing up.
"By the way, Long Tao, do you have any plans to publicize Di Nian as a chess piece in the Yixian Diagram?"
Long Tao thought for a while before speaking, "I will do it, but not now. At least wait until the situation is stable again."
After hearing this, Yin Zhe felt a hint of satisfaction that he couldn't hide.
"I knew your kid wouldn't be confused."
The two said nothing more, just looked at each other and smiled. Just when Yin Zhe stood up and was about to leave, Long Tao thought of something again.
Suddenly he asked,
"Yin Zhe, if you hadn't taken that medicine and continued to practice, would it be possible to become a powerful person?"
Yin Zhe was obviously a little surprised by this question and couldn't help laughing and said,
"I thought that since you have been with me for so long, you should understand how useless I am."
"Frankly, I don't understand." Long Tao rarely looked at him seriously.
"You have been saying that you are not good enough since I left. But I don't know your true talent at all. You always say that you are just Bai Yujing's outer disciple, but that is Bai Yujing. Even if you are the worst, in the eyes of mortals, you must be a person with outstanding talent."
Yin Zhe opened his mouth, as if he was blocked by something. He was silent for a while, then smiled coquettishly,
"Bai Yujing... also has backdoors and letters of recommendation. My family got one at that time, and I was lucky enough to grab it. Okay, okay, don't ask about these trivial matters from the past, I'm leaving first."
Looking at the other party's leaving figure, Long Tao knew that he was perfunctory again. The family that could get Bai Yujing's recommendation letter must also be a top immortal cultivating family. The one who could get the recommendation letter from such a family must be the best disciple of the family.
